nodes.description: Account.owner: address with full control over the account (ownership transfer, admin grant/revoke).
Account.admins: mapping of addresses granted the admin role, able to grant/revoke operators.
Account.operators: mapping of addresses allowed to withdraw assets and invoke arbitrary calls.
AccountFactory.governance: address allowed to change the account base and governance.
AccountFactory.accountBase: implementation contract used as the base for created Account proxies.
AccountFactory.accounts: mapping from user address to the latest Account proxy created for it.
Initializable.initialized: guards against double initialization of the account.
Initializable.initializing: reentrancy-style guard used while running the initializer.
EIP-1967 storage slot holding the proxy implementation address.
EIP-1967 storage slot holding the proxy admin address.
Initializer that sets the owner and grants the initial admin roles.
Transfers account ownership; only callable by the current owner.
Grants the admin role to an address; only owner.
Revokes the admin role from an address; only owner.
Grants the operator role; only owner or admin.
Revokes the operator role; only owner or admin.
Read-only check whether an address is owner, admin or operator.
Operator-only ETH withdrawal to an arbitrary payable target using transfer().
Operator-only ERC20 withdrawal to an arbitrary target using SafeERC20.
Operator-only ERC20 withdrawal that falls through to owner allowance when the account balance is insufficient.
Operator-only function approving an arbitrary spender for an ERC20 allowance.
Operator-only generic call to an arbitrary target with arbitrary value and data.
Deploys an AdminUpgradeabilityProxy backed Account for msg.sender and initializes it.
Updates the base account implementation; only governance.
Updates the governance address; only current governance.
Assembly delegatecall forwarding calldata to the implementation and returning raw data.
Fallback path calling _willFallback then _delegate(_implementation()).
Validates the new implementation is a contract and writes it to IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT via sstore.
Writes the new admin address into ADMIN_SLOT via sstore.
ifAdmin-guarded admin transfer; non-admin callers are delegated to the implementation.
ifAdmin-guarded implementation upgrade; non-admin callers are delegated.
Proxy constructor validating slots and setting implementation and admin.
Caller-controlled address used for all ownership, admin and operator authorization checks.
ETH .transfer() to an operator-supplied targetAddress in Account.withdraw.
Arbitrary target.call{value:data} in Account.invoke, forwarding value and user-controlled calldata.
Assembly delegatecall to the implementation address inside Proxy._delegate.
Raw sstore into IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT changing the proxy target.
Raw sstore into ADMIN_SLOT changing the proxy admin.
Low-level call with value in Address.functionCall/_functionCallWithValue reached from SafeERC20._callOptionalReturn.

edges.reason: msg.sender is compared against owner in the transferOwnership require, gating ownership transfer.
msg.sender must equal owner before granting an admin role.
msg.sender must equal owner before revoking an admin role.
msg.sender must be owner or admin before granting an operator role.
msg.sender must be owner or admin before revoking an operator role.
msg.sender is passed to isOperator from the onlyOperator modifier.
onlyOperator modifier authorizes withdraw based on msg.sender.
onlyOperator modifier authorizes withdrawToken based on msg.sender.
onlyOperator modifier authorizes withdrawTokenFallThrough based on msg.sender.
onlyOperator modifier authorizes approveToken based on msg.sender.
onlyOperator modifier authorizes invoke based on msg.sender.
createAccount uses msg.sender as proxy admin, account owner and initializer caller.
setAccountBase requires msg.sender to equal governance.
setGovernance requires msg.sender to equal governance.
ifAdmin modifier on changeAdmin compares msg.sender with the stored admin.
ifAdmin modifier on changeImplementation compares msg.sender with the stored admin.
initialize writes the new owner into the owner state variable.
initialize loop sets admins[_initialAdmins[i]] = true.
transferOwnership overwrites the owner state variable.
grantAdmin sets admins[_account] = true.
revokeAdmin sets admins[_account] = false.
grantOperator sets operators[_account] = true.
revokeOperator sets operators[_account] = false.
isOperator reads the owner state variable.
withdrawTokenFallThrough reads owner as the source of the safeTransferFrom fall-through.
createAccount writes accounts[msg.sender] = address(account).
setAccountBase overwrites the accountBase state variable.
setGovernance overwrites the governance state variable.
constructor asserts the IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT constant value.
constructor asserts the ADMIN_SLOT constant value.
_setImplementation reads IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT before the sstore.
_setAdmin reads ADMIN_SLOT before the sstore.
withdraw transfers ETH to an operator-supplied address, granting control flow to an external account before the event is emitted.
invoke performs an arbitrary external call with value before emitting the Invoked event, allowing reentrant callbacks.
_delegate hands execution to the implementation via delegatecall, which can re-enter the proxy.
withdrawToken reaches SafeERC20 low-level call on an attacker-controlled token address.
withdrawTokenFallThrough reaches SafeERC20 low-level calls on an attacker-controlled token address.
approveToken reaches SafeERC20 low-level approve call on an attacker-controlled token address.
_setImplementation writes the new implementation into IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT.
_setAdmin writes the new admin into ADMIN_SLOT.
_fallback calls _delegate after running _willFallback.
changeAdmin calls _setAdmin with the new admin.
ifAdmin delegates non-admin callers of changeAdmin into _fallback and thus into the implementation.
changeImplementation calls _setImplementation with the new implementation.
ifAdmin delegates non-admin callers of changeImplementation into _fallback and thus into the implementation.
constructor calls _setImplementation(_logic).
constructor calls _setAdmin(_admin).
createAccount deploys a new AdminUpgradeabilityProxy, invoking its constructor.
createAccount calls account.initialize(msg.sender, _initialAdmins).
_owner parameter flows into the owner assignment in initialize.
_initialAdmins parameter drives the admins mapping writes in initialize.
loop index i controls iteration over _initialAdmins in initialize.
_owner parameter is stored into owner in transferOwnership.
_account parameter keys the admins mapping in grantAdmin.
_account parameter keys the admins mapping in revokeAdmin.
_account parameter keys the operators mapping in grantOperator.
_account parameter keys the operators mapping in revokeOperator.
userAddress is checked against owner, admins and operators in isOperator.
targetAddress parameter becomes the recipient of the ETH transfer.
amount parameter becomes the value of the ETH transfer.
tokenAddress parameter selects the ERC20 contract in withdrawToken.
targetAddress parameter is the recipient in withdrawToken.
amount parameter is the transferred value in withdrawToken.
tokenAddress parameter selects the ERC20 contract in withdrawTokenFallThrough.
targetAddress parameter is the recipient in withdrawTokenFallThrough.
amount parameter bounds the withdrawal and fall-through amounts.
tokenBalance local controls the branch between direct transfer and fall-through.
tokenAddress parameter selects the ERC20 contract in approveToken.
targetAddress parameter is the spender approved in approveToken.
amount parameter is the approved allowance in approveToken.
target parameter becomes the callee of the arbitrary call in invoke.
value parameter becomes the ETH value forwarded by the call in invoke.
data parameter becomes the raw calldata of the call in invoke.
result local receives the raw return data of the low-level call in invoke.
_initialAdmins parameter is forwarded to account.initialize in createAccount.
proxy local holds the deployed AdminUpgradeabilityProxy inside createAccount.
account local holds the Account interface over the proxy and is returned by createAccount.
_accountBase parameter is stored into accountBase in setAccountBase.
_governance parameter is stored into governance in setGovernance.
implementation parameter is the delegatecall target inside _delegate.
newImplementation parameter is validated and stored by _setImplementation.
newAdmin parameter is stored into ADMIN_SLOT by _setAdmin.
newAdmin parameter is forwarded to _setAdmin from changeAdmin.
newImplementation parameter is forwarded to _setImplementation from changeImplementation.

normalization_plan.reason: Function parameter only meaningful inside the initialize core function; fold into it.
Initial admin array is consumed solely by initialize.
Loop counter has scope only inside initialize.
Ownership target is only used by transferOwnership.
Admin being granted is local to grantAdmin.
Admin being revoked is local to revokeAdmin.
Operator being granted is local to grantOperator.
Operator being revoked is local to revokeOperator.
Checked address is local to the isOperator view function.
Recipient directly parameterizes the ETH transfer operation.
Amount directly parameterizes the ETH transfer operation.
Token address is only used by withdrawToken.
Recipient is only used by withdrawToken.
Amount is only used by withdrawToken.
Token address is only used by withdrawTokenFallThrough.
Recipient is only used by withdrawTokenFallThrough.
Amount is only used by withdrawTokenFallThrough.
Balance local exists only to branch inside withdrawTokenFallThrough.
Token address is only used by approveToken.
Spender address is only used by approveToken.
Allowance amount is only used by approveToken.
Target address directly parameterizes the arbitrary external call.
Value directly parameterizes the ETH forwarded by the arbitrary call.
Calldata directly parameterizes the arbitrary external call.
Return-data local is scoped to invoke.
Initial admin list is forwarded by createAccount to initialize.
Proxy local only exists during createAccount.
Account handle local only exists during createAccount.
New base address is only used by setAccountBase.
New governance address is only used by setGovernance.
Implementation address is the sole argument of the delegatecall routine.
New implementation is only used to validate and write the implementation slot.
New admin is only written into the admin slot.
New admin argument is forwarded to _setAdmin by changeAdmin.
New implementation argument is forwarded to _setImplementation by changeImplementation.
